problem.explanation: LEFT JOIN keeps customers even without matching orders. SUM groups all matching orders and COALESCE converts the no-match NULL to zero. A common mistake is using INNER JOIN, which drops customers without orders. Pre-aggregating orders in a CTE is useful for larger queries.
hints: Use the join that preserves every customer.
Aggregate order amounts and wrap the missing sum with COALESCE.
problem.reference_solution: SELECT c.name, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS total FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.name;
problem.statement_markdown: Return every customer name and total order amount, including customers with no orders as total 0. Sort by customer name.
problem.title: Customer order totals
